preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of plans q must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each mineral resource label a_i must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct cities within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan must have valid city indices and mineral resource range.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(c_i for c_i in results) else any(c_i for c_i in results)
postconditions.description: Output -1 if no valid mineral resource exists for any plan, otherwise output the valid mineral resource.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i in range(l_i, r_i + 1) for c_i, l_i, r_i in zip(results, plans))
postconditions.description: Each output mineral resource c_i must be within the specified range [l_i, r_i].

postconditions.expression: all(c_i in odd_count for c_i in results)
postconditions.description: Each output mineral resource c_i must appear an odd number of times between cities u_i and v_i.
